shortlist: Macular Retinal Vein Occlusion with Chronic Cystoid Macular Edema

shortlist.label: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO)
shortlist.why_kept: Persistent vision loss, severe macular changes, and edema are consistent with CRVO

shortlist.label: Macular Retinal Vein Occlusion with Chronic Cystoid Macular Edema
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic cystoid macular edema and persistent central macular thickness are characteristic of this condition

shortlist.label: Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO)
shortlist.why_kept: Vision loss and macular edema can occur in BRVO, although the presence of severe macular changes and persistent central macular thickness makes CRVO more likely

shortlist.label: Diabetic Macular Edema
shortlist.why_kept: Although the patient's history does not mention diabetes, diabetic macular edema is a possible cause of vision loss and macular edema

shortlist.label: Hypertensive Retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's history of hypertension and multiple strokes increases the likelihood of hypertensive retinopathy, which can cause vision loss and macular changes

s4.champion: Macular Retinal Vein Occlusion with Chronic Cystoid Macular Edema

raw.champion: Macular Retinal Vein Occlusion with Chronic Cystoid Macular Edema
raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of vision loss, severe macular changes with associated edema, and persistent central macular thickness as shown by spectral-domain optical coherence tomography findings are most consistent with macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema, especially given the history of hypertension and hyperlipidemia which are risk factors for retinal vein occlusion.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO)
rejected.why: While CRVO could explain some symptoms, the specific mention of 'macular changes' and 'chronic cystoid macular edema' points more towards a condition directly affecting the macula.

rejected.label: Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO)
rejected.why: BRVO typically affects a branch of the retinal vein and might not fully account for the widespread macular changes described.

rejected.label: Diabetic Macular Edema
rejected.why: There is no mention of diabetes in the patient's history, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Hypertensive Retinopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has hypertension, the specific symptoms and findings, especially the chronic cystoid macular edema, are more indicative of a retinal vein occlusion than hypertensive retinopathy alone.
